scope: Synthetic schema probes, not business diagnosis or accuracy evaluation. No live business records changed.

hypotheses.explanation: A technical disruption in the checkout funnel or payment gateway could be preventing customers from completing purchases, leading to an observed revenue change.
hypotheses.mechanism: Payment processing errors or checkout page failures block transaction completion after items are added to the cart.
expectedObservations: Sharp drop in checkout completion rate while cart additions remain stable
Elevated error logs or payment gateway timeout rates
missingEvidence: Payment processor error rates and latency logs
falsificationTests: If checkout conversion rates and payment success rates remain unchanged across all devices and payment methods during the period of interest, this hypothesis is falsified.
hypotheses.chronology: No temporal data is currently available to establish when the revenue observation began relative to checkout system changes.
confounders: Tracking pixel or analytics reporting outage
Simultaneous shifts in traffic quality from advertising campaigns
hypotheses.controlComparison: Compare checkout completion rates across unaffected payment methods, browsers, or regions against the affected scope.

hypotheses.explanation: Inventory depletion on high-volume products could restrict purchasable supply and cause a decline in overall revenue.
hypotheses.mechanism: Unavailable stock prevents customers from adding key products to their carts or completing orders.
expectedObservations: Zero available inventory recorded for top-selling products
Drop in product page add-to-cart rate coinciding with out-of-stock status
missingEvidence: Product-level revenue and unit sales breakdown
falsificationTests: If inventory levels for all major products remained adequately stocked and available for purchase throughout the observation window, this hypothesis is falsified.
hypotheses.chronology: No timeline is available to verify whether inventory depletion preceded the revenue observation.
confounders: Catalog or pricing display bugs hiding in-stock items
Seasonal demand shifts affecting specific product lines
hypotheses.controlComparison: Compare sales performance of fully stocked products against products experiencing low or zero inventory.

hypotheses.explanation: With no supporting observations or measurement data available, the revenue observation cannot be attributed to a specific operational, marketing, or external factor, including potential measurement or reporting artifacts.
hypotheses.mechanism: Unobserved operational changes, external shifts, or data pipeline reporting anomalies alter recorded revenue.
expectedObservations: Discrepancies between order database records and analytics reporting, or unmonitored system changes
missingEvidence: Data pipeline integrity checks and full operational metrics
falsificationTests: If complete, verified operational metrics clearly isolate a single well-defined causal mechanism with corroborating control comparisons, the unknown classification is superseded.
hypotheses.chronology: No chronological observations are present in the input.
confounders: Measurement definition changes or delayed data ingestion
hypotheses.controlComparison: Compare raw backend transaction ledger totals against aggregated reporting views across unaffected business segments.

value.decisionSummary: No evidence, tools, or remaining investigation rounds are available. Formulated three competing unconfirmed hypotheses (checkout_failure, stockout, and unknown) with concrete falsification checks, confounders, and control comparisons, and stopped due to insufficient evidence.
value.stopReason: Insufficient evidence: no observations, tools, external research, or investigation rounds are available to evaluate or discriminate between competing hypotheses.
